description: View competitive rankings and see how you compare to other learners. Filter by time range (daily/weekly/monthly/all-time) and optionally by specific course. Shows top performers (podium), your position highlighted, and detailed statistics. Use auto_page=true to automatically show the page containing your rank. FREE call that does NOT count against rate limits.

auto_page.description: Auto-navigate to the page containing your rank. When true, ignores page parameter and shows your position.

course_id.description: Optional course ID to filter leaderboard by specific course

limit.description: Number of entries per page (default: 10, max: 50)

time_range.description: Time range filter: daily, weekly, monthly, or all-time

name: show_leaderboard
title: View Leaderboard
